tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Enumerate the shop category taxonomy: every category slug currently carried by at least one public shop, together with how many public shops carry it. Call this BEFORE passing `category` to find_shop — the taxonomy is flat (no parent/child hierarchy, e.g. "fashion" and "womens-clothing" are siblings

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: Fetch a single merchant/shop by id or domain (public view). Returns "shop not found" for shops still under internal review, identical to a genuinely unknown domain — reviewers cannot be distinguished from typos. The offers array is present for schema stability but empty until merchant offers are ing

tools.name: list_coupons
tools.description: List currently USABLE discount codes/coupons, optionally filtered by shop_domain (e.g. "otto.de"). A code is withheld from `results` when it is EXPIRED (valid_until has passed), when a real checkout test PROVED it does not work (verification_status "verified_rejected"), or when a display policy supp

tools.name: get_shipping_policy
tools.description: What a shop STATES about its own shipping: which destinations it names, the delivery time it claims, and any free-shipping threshold — plus the date that statement was last checked and where it was read (policy_page or structured_data). This is a shop-level statement, NOT an offer and NOT a quote: i

tools.name: get_trust
tools.description: Trust-relevant facts OpenShopGraph itself measured about one merchant/shop (by id or domain): TLS certificate issuer and grade, hosting ISP and country, domain registration date, registrar, and accepted payment methods. tools.name: report_code
tools.description: Record that a specific shop_domain + code (coupon) pair is wrong in one of four fixed, documented ways (invalid | mismatch | item_restricted | min_order_missing — see reasons enum; no free text anywhere). This is a write: it appends one new report row and NEVER changes the delivered coupon directly

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Record a shop-level or data-fact issue as one fixed, documented reason (no free text). subject_type "shop": unreachable | no_longer_exists | info_outdated | wrong_category | wrong_name_or_domain. subject_type "fact": shipping_cost | return_period | payment_methods | evidence_broken. Same write seman

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "report_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_shop" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
